summary: Backend-only testing for NL BUS. Created pytest suite covering all 10 listed features (lines, line detail, nearby stops, stop detail, register w/ duplicate 409, login valid+401, auth/me w/ Bearer, favorites CRUD, ratings POST+GET, planner sorted by total_min). All 16 tests passed against public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL.

minor.issue: Returns HTTP 200 instead of the more conventional 201 Created, but matches the response_model and frontend contract.
Accepts anonymous ratings (user optional). This is intentional per code (uses get_current_user not require_user) but worth confirming with product spec.
Default radius_km=2.0 silently returns [] if no stops within 2km; frontend should either widen radius or inform user. Behaviour otherwise correct.

action_items: Backend is fully functional for MVP; no fixes required.
Consider documenting in README that /api/ratings allows anonymous submissions if that is intended.
Optional: return 201 on register for REST convention (not blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~630 lines - still manageable, but close to the 700-line split threshold. Consider splitting into routes/auth.py, routes/lines.py, routes/stops.py, routes/favorites.py, routes/ratings.py, routes/planner.py when adding more features.
datetime.now() used in next_arrival() without tz; server timezone affects next_arrival accuracy. Should use America/Sao_Paulo explicitly.
No index on db.users.email or db.lines.id / db.stops.id - fine for seed scale but add indexes before production.
JWT_SECRET read from env (good). No refresh-token flow, 30-day TTL may be too long - acceptable for MVP.
seed_data_creation: Created transient test users with TEST_<uuid>@nlbus.app prefix and one rating on line-202 (comment 'TEST ótimo'). Pre-existing test@nlbus.app/senha1234 verified working.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. 7 lines, 18 stops seeded (NOT 18 as problem statement says - count is 18 stops which includes Nova Lima + BH/Raposos/Rio Acima/Sabará). Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_nlbus_api.py for regression. Public URL via EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL env. Pre-existing test user test@nlbus.app / senha1234.
